    - name: Strict actionlint duplicate YAML keys Actions inputs ShellCheck
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        archive='project/VEUX_R39_R2_MEMORY_ABI_MAIN.zip'
        printf '%s  %s\n' '745d80b8502a9beea513a2e7a58bb59272539b7508920d235ce2e79741bda528' "$archive" | sha256sum -c -
        unzip -p "$archive" tools/actionlint > "$R55_STAGE/actionlint"
        chmod 0755 "$R55_STAGE/actionlint"
        "$R55_STAGE/actionlint" -version | grep -Fx '1.7.12'
        "$R55_STAGE/actionlint" -color=false -shellcheck='' 'project/.github/workflows/VEUX_R55E2_SUSFS54_SUPER_SUS_MOUNT_SOURCE_ONLY.yml' > "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_ACTIONLINT.log"
        printf 'R55E2_ACTIONLINT=PASS\n' >> "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_ACTIONLINT.log"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55E2_YAML_AUDIT'
        import pathlib,hashlib,subprocess,yaml
        class Unique(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
        def no_duplicates(loader,node):
            result={}
            for kn,vn in node.value:
                k=loader.construct_object(kn)
                if k in result:raise RuntimeError('DUPLICATE_YAML_KEY:'+str(k))
                result[k]=loader.construct_object(vn)
            return result
        Unique.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,no_duplicates)
        w=yaml.load(pathlib.Path('project/.github/workflows/VEUX_R55E2_SUSFS54_SUPER_SUS_MOUNT_SOURCE_ONLY.yml').read_text('utf-8'),Loader=Unique)
        assert list(w['on'])==['workflow_dispatch'] and w['permissions']=={'contents':'read'}
        assert set(w['jobs'])=={'r55e2_source'}
        j=w['jobs']['r55e2_source'];s=j['steps']
        assert j['runs-on']=='ubuntu-24.04' and j['timeout-minutes']==35
        expected=chr(36)+chr(123)+chr(123)+" github.repository == 'Chrizz100/veux-nongki-universal-kernel' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' "+chr(125)+chr(125)
        assert j['if']==expected
        assert len(s)==9
        for i in (0,1):
            assert s[i]['uses']=='actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683'
            assert s[i]['with']['persist-credentials'] is False
        assert s[1]['with']['repository']=='dereference23/kernel_xiaomi_sm6375'
        assert s[1]['with']['ref']=='b2b7a3bbc36d120ee523ebc8d68e0f13a97df632'
        assert s[8]['uses']=='actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02'
        assert s[8]['with']['path']=='/tmp/veux-r55e2/out/'
        assert s[8]['with']['if-no-files-found']=='error' and s[8]['with']['retention-days']==14
        log=[]
        for step in s:
            if 'run' not in step:continue
            body=step['run']
            if chr(36)+chr(123) in body:raise RuntimeError('GITHUB_EXPRESSION_IN_RUN_BLOCK')
            for command in (['bash','-n','-'],['shellcheck','--shell=bash','--severity=warning','-']):
                q=subprocess.run(command,input=body,text=True,capture_output=True)
                if q.returncode:raise RuntimeError('BASH_OR_SHELLCHECK:'+step['name']+':'+q.stdout+q.stderr)
            log.append(step['name']+' BASH_SHELLCHECK_PASS SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest())
        pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55e2/R55E2_SHELLCHECK.log').write_text('\n'.join(log)+'\n')
        print('R55E2_STRICT_YAML_ACTION_INPUTS_SHELLCHECK=PASS')
        PY_R55E2_YAML_AUDIT

        import ast,pathlib

    - name: Replay pinned R55E1 and port fs/super.c SUS_MOUNT on real 5.4 source
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 -B "$R55_STAGE/scripts/r55e2_super.py" \
          --source kernel --base "$R55_STAGE/inputs/R55E1_AUTHENTIC_18FILES.patch" \
          --out "$R55_STAGE/out" 2>&1 | tee "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_REAL_SOURCE.log"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55E2_POST'
        import pathlib,json,hashlib
        out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55e2/out')
        r=json.loads((out/'R55E2_RESULT.json').read_text('utf-8'))
        assert r['r55e1_input_sha256']=='a95b686a4c2d3a86f572868e715c6e6c30b4c9736b6d43a6056b8455340efc79'
        assert r['files_total']==19 and r['super_sus_mount_minor_range_staged'] is True
        assert r['super_stock_blob']=='47ca7dc0e6c3d37a3026bec2ea90b2a0d6d14add'
        assert r['original_super_ida_and_free_paths_preserved'] is True
        assert r['kernel_compiled'] is False and r['flash_allowed'] is False
        p=out/'VEUX_R55E2_SUSFS54_19_FILES_SUPER_SUS_MOUNT_NOFLASH.patch'
        assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['complete_19_file_patch_sha256']
        print('R55E2_REAL_PINNED_SOURCE_POSTCHECK=PASS')
        PY_R55E2_POST
    - name: Independent exact clean 19-file source Git replay
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git -C kernel worktree add --detach "$R55_STAGE/replay" b2b7a3bbc36d120ee523ebc8d68e0f13a97df632
        patch="$R55_STAGE/out/VEUX_R55E2_SUSFS54_19_FILES_SUPER_SUS_MOUNT_NOFLASH.patch"
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" apply --check --whitespace=error "$patch"
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" apply --whitespace=error "$patch"
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" add -N -- fs/susfs.c include/linux/susfs.h include/linux/susfs_def.h
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" diff --check
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" apply --reverse --check "$patch"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55E2_REPLAY'
        import pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,json,sys
        stage=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55e2');repo=pathlib.Path('kernel');replay=stage/'replay';out=stage/'out'
        sys.path.insert(0,str(stage/'scripts'))
        import r55e2_super as port
        def run(*args):return subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
        files=set(run('git','-C',str(replay),'diff','--name-only').decode().splitlines())
        assert files==port.EXPECTED,('SCOPE_DRIFT',sorted(files^port.EXPECTED))
        for name in sorted(files):
            assert hashlib.sha256((repo/name).read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256((replay/name).read_bytes()).digest(),name
        assert run('git','-C',str(replay),'diff','--binary','--no-ext-diff')==(out/port.TOTAL_NAME).read_bytes(),'DIFF_BYTES_MISMATCH'
        r=json.loads((out/port.RESULT_NAME).read_text('utf-8'))
        r['source_replay_verified']=True
        (out/port.RESULT_NAME).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n','utf-8')
        print('R55E2_INDEPENDENT_19_FILE_BYTE_IDENTICAL_REPLAY=PASS')
        PY_R55E2_REPLAY
    - name: Final scope SHA-256 and NOFLASH gate
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        cp "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_ACTIONLINT.log" "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_SHELLCHECK.log" \
           "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_TESTS.log" "$R55_STAGE/R55E2_REAL_SOURCE.log" "$R55_STAGE/out/"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55E2_FINAL'
        import pathlib,json,hashlib
        out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55e2/out')
        r=json.loads((out/'R55E2_RESULT.json').read_text('utf-8'))
        assert r['source_replay_verified'] is True and r['files_total']==19
        assert r['super_sus_mount_minor_range_staged'] and r['original_super_ida_and_free_paths_preserved']
        for flag in ('kernel_compiled','full_susfs_port','baka_su_uapi6_integrated',
                     'nomount_v22_integrated','device_tested','brene_changed',
                     'vendor_changed','boot_ready','flash_allowed','user_repo_modified',
                     'runtime_semantics_review_complete'):
            assert r[flag] is False,flag
        assert len([p for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file()])==8
        (out/'SHA256SUMS.txt').write_text(''.join(
           hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  '+p.name+'\n'
           for p in sorted(out.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name!='SHA256SUMS.txt'))
        print('R55E2_FINAL_19_FILE_SCOPE_SHA256_NOFLASH=PASS')
        PY_R55E2_FINAL
        (cd "$R55_STAGE/out" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
        [ -z "$(git -C project status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]
        echo 'R55E2_USER_REPO_UNMODIFIED; NO_KERNEL_BUILD; NO_FLASH'
    - name: Upload only 19-file source patch and audit proofs
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02

        name: VEUX-R55E2-SUPER-SUSMOUNT-19FILES-NOFLASH-${{ github.run_id }}

        retention-days: 14
        if-no-files-found: error
